input_root_policy: Caller supplies a local root explicitly. These are portable relative staging paths, not existing source-cache locations. No restoration or copying is performed.

fixture.name: Existing Watauga v3 two-issue local day-custody qualification

requirements.message: Seal the complete NextGen overlay, t-route source, component submodule commits and all build dependency versions; preserved hashes alone are not a complete public source bundle.
Bind SLOTH, NoahOWP and CFE source revisions, compiler/dependency identities and built shared-library hashes to the pinned runtime image.
Restore the exact Watauga fixture, resolve unknown member hashes against its sealed contract and validate forcing coverage, units, physical configuration and original origin.
Verify the loader resolves the exported libiso_c_bmi.so with SHA-256 09b65b5c2a76df4e8e9b334b9d3c56f39c327955306085cae692484742dcc162; the historical build embeds a private build-directory RPATH.
Execute and retain a clean, bounded Linux ARM64 build with a complete toolchain and dependency lock; this profile does not attest a new build.
Retain a new real Watauga serial/reference comparison, isolation and recovery receipts at declared tolerances; historical receipts and unit tests are separate evidence.
Resolve code, image, component and fixture redistribution rights and notices before including inherited payloads in a release.

recovery_rule: Reconstruct land and channel state by identical historical replay from the declared original origin. Routing q0 is not a complete land checkpoint. Production 2018-origin forcing cannot silently replace the 2021 fixture.
